slides.headline: THE PRESIDENT JUST HELD AN OFFICIAL SUPER INTELLIGENCE MEETING
slides.kicker: THE FIRST OFFICIAL WHITE HOUSE SUPERINTELLIGENCE SUMMIT

caption:
The White House just held an official 'Super Intelligence' AI meeting

On September 29, 2026, the President held a White House meeting formally titled 'Super Intelligence,' putting the thing from sci-fi movies on his actual calendar. Elon Musk, who sued OpenAI and has warned that AI could destroy civilization, hyped the meeting. Your industry just got a new player at the table: the White House, now officially treating superintelligence as a real priority.

Musk's amplifying post drew 7.2 million views. This is the first time a sitting U.S. president has put superintelligence on an official White House calendar.
Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: elonmusk on X, MargoMartin47 on X

#AI #ArtificialIntelligence #WhiteHouse #SuperIntelligence #Technology

[2] has a solid 'FIRST' superlative, but it's just announcing good news without the narrative reversal that makes you actually curious.
